row.body: The festival schedule is marked complete before the gates opened; a note leaves one band’s arrival time blank and asks the crew to keep the side road clear.
row.title: Festival schedule copy

sidecar.gloss: An event is marked complete before its performers arrive.
sidecar.rival_reading: A normal event can change its schedule and traffic plan; the blank time does not show an emergency order.
